domain: distributed systems reliability and workflow consistency
axioms: A message or artifact can be internally valid yet stale relative to the receiver's current state.
Independent workers do not share state unless the protocol makes that state explicit and durable.
Retries are normal execution paths and must be safe after partial success, not only after clean failure.
End-to-end correctness requires identity and causality across every handoff, not correctness within each role in isolation.
Concurrent mutations turn implicit ordering assumptions into races.
A failure detector can be wrong, so protocols must distinguish worker failure, environment failure, and delayed evidence.
failure_mode: It can over-formalize a mostly sequential, human-supervised workflow and impose protocol cost beyond the observed race risk.
It does not determine whether Opus adds semantic judgment or whether a token metric reflects economic value.
It tends to treat model behavior as node reliability and may miss capability-specific reasoning failures that are not state-transfer faults.
